name: Khepri Scarab Dawn Engine
loreTies: A mobile dawn-engine guardian from Khepra gateworks, not a robot copy of Egyptian myth but the source-culture machine humans later misunderstood as sacred scarab power.
Advances slowly, guards Gates, and forces AoE decisions around hard shell armor.
source culture humans later copied as Egyptian solar myth
shortBackstory: Khepri Scarab Dawn Engine is a lore-faithful Aten Ra run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Khepri Scarab Dawn Engine belongs to The Solar Dominion of Khepra and exists to express Aten Ra law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Advances slowly, guards Gates, and forces AoE decisions around hard shell armor.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Titanic scarab-forge body of electrum, Nile-black silt glass legs, sun core under royal linen-light membranes. Abilities — Dawn Roll, Wingflare Guard, Silt-Glass Crush — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
